Each request lists item options ("0/3 of: radish x5, pea x5, ...": deliver any 3 of the options in the listed quantities) or a coin payment. Items come from farming (buy seeds, plant, water, harvest; crops grow for several days and only in their season), foraging, fishing, mining, chopping wood, crafting machines that process goods, and the shops. Deliver hands in held items that fill open request slots (a slot needs its full quantity); coin requests are paid with PayCoins(...).

Time: a day runs from 06:00 until you Sleep; staying up past 02:00 makes you pass out. Every action costs in-game minutes and most cost energy; sleeping restores energy. Seasons last 24 days.

Your task is one segment of a longer run. Complete ANY ONE new restoration request as fast as possible, in in-game time, before the segment's deadline (usually 7 days). Finishing sooner gives a higher score. A failed segment earns only small partial credit for moving an open request forward. Tool calls and day-plan lengths are capped, so plan whole days at once.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Full text state (date, location, energy, money, bag, crops, machines, open requests with items held) plus segment progress.

tools.name: list_actions
tools.description: Macro actions valid right now, grouped: Verb(a|b) means Verb(a) or Verb(b); Buy(x,1|5) means Buy(x,1) or Buy(x,5).

tools.name: act
tools.description: Run one macro or a day plan (list of macros run in order; stops at the first invalid name, when the day ends, or when the segment ends). Returns results, the new compact state and progress.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Compact state and segment progress (time, day-ends left, tool calls left, invalid actions).
